WITH execution_order_types AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT o.recordvault, o.ordertune
  FROM orderexecutions oe
  JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = oe.ordersmark
),
type_counts AS (
  SELECT ordertune, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM execution_order_types
  GROUP BY ordertune
),
type_shares AS (
  SELECT ordertune, order_count,
         CAST(order_count AS REAL) / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM type_counts
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT order_count, share,
         share - AVG(share) OVER () AS excess_share
  FROM type_shares
  WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM type_shares)
)
SELECT SUM(order_count) AS sum_counts,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(excess_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average;
